<?php
/**
 * TokenVerifier - Kubernetes service authentication module
 * Handles inter-service HMAC token verification for microservice mesh
 * 
 * Deployed via: k8s/deployments/auth-service.yaml
 * ConfigMap: auth-config (namespace: prod)
 */

namespace App\Security;

use App\Cache\TokenCache;
use App\Logging\AuditLogger;

class TokenVerifier
{
    private string $secretKey;
    private TokenCache $cache;
    private AuditLogger $logger;
    private int $tokenTtl;
    private string $algorithm;

    public function __construct(
        string $secretKey,
        TokenCache $cache,
        AuditLogger $logger,
        int $tokenTtl = 300,
        string $algorithm = 'sha256'
    ) {
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
        $this->cache = $cache;
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->tokenTtl = $tokenTtl;
        $this->algorithm = $algorithm;
    }

    /**
     * Verify an incoming service-to-service authentication token
     * Token format: base64(timestamp:nonce:payload):base64(hmac_signature)
     */
    public function verifyServiceToken(string $rawToken, string $serviceId): bool
    {
        $parts = explode(':', $rawToken, 2);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            $this->logger->logFailure($serviceId, 'malformed_token');
            return false;
        }

        [$encodedPayload, $encodedSignature] = $parts;

        $payload = base64_decode($encodedPayload, true);
        $signature = base64_decode($encodedSignature, true);

        if ($payload === false || $signature === false) {
            $this->logger->logFailure($serviceId, 'invalid_encoding');
            return false;
        }

        // Check replay protection via nonce cache
        $payloadParts = explode('|', $payload, 3);
        if (count($payloadParts) !== 3) {
            $this->logger->logFailure($serviceId, 'invalid_payload_structure');
            return false;
        }

        [$timestamp, $nonce, $data] = $payloadParts;

        // Validate timestamp freshness
        if (!$this->isTimestampValid((int)$timestamp)) {
            $this->logger->logFailure($serviceId, 'expired_token');
            return false;
        }

        // Check nonce hasn't been used (replay protection)
        if ($this->cache->hasNonce($nonce)) {
            $this->logger->logFailure($serviceId, 'replay_detected');
            return false;
        }

        // Compute expected HMAC
        $expectedSignature = $this->computeHmac($encodedPayload, $serviceId);

        // Verify signature integrity
        if (!$this->compareSignatures($signature, $expectedSignature)) {
            $this->logger->logFailure($serviceId, 'signature_mismatch');
            return false;
        }

        // Store nonce to prevent replay
        $this->cache->storeNonce($nonce, $this->tokenTtl);
        $this->logger->logSuccess($serviceId, $data);

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Compute HMAC for the given payload bound to a specific service
     */
    private function computeHmac(string $payload, string $serviceId): string
    {
        $context = $serviceId . '::' . $this->algorithm;
        $derivedKey = hash_hmac('sha256', $context, $this->secretKey, true);
        return hash_hmac($this->algorithm, $payload, $derivedKey, true);
    }

    /**
     * Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
     * Uses double-HMAC pattern for additional protection against
     * variable-length timing leaks.
     */
    private function compareSignatures(string $provided, string $expected): bool
    {
        // Double-HMAC comparison pattern - both sides are HMACed with
        // a random key so even if comparison leaks timing, the actual
        // signature bytes are not revealed
        $comparisonKey = random_bytes(32);

        $hmacProvided = hash_hmac('sha256', $provided, $comparisonKey, true);
        $hmacExpected = hash_hmac('sha256', $expected, $comparisonKey, true);

        // Length pre-check for the HMAC outputs (always 32 bytes for sha256)
        if (strlen($hmacProvided) !== strlen($hmacExpected)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Use hash_equals for constant-time comparison of the
        // double-HMAC outputs - belt and suspenders approach
        return hash_equals($hmacExpected, $hmacProvided);
    }

    private function isTimestampValid(int $timestamp): bool
    {
        $now = time();
        $drift = abs($now - $timestamp);
        return $drift <= $this->tokenTtl;
    }

    /**
     * Generate a token for outbound service calls
     */
    public function generateServiceToken(string $serviceId, string $data): string
    {
        $timestamp = time();
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $payload = implode('|', [$timestamp, $nonce, $data]);
        $encodedPayload = base64_encode($payload);

        $signature = $this->computeHmac($encodedPayload, $serviceId);
        $encodedSignature = base64_encode($signature);

        return $encodedPayload . ':' . $encodedSignature;
    }
}
